d: A generation raised on smartphones is rediscovering life beyond the screen. Sudoku, knitting, journaling, film cameras and vinyl records are finding new fans among Gen Z. The reason? Digital fatigue. And this is becoming more than a lifestyle trend. From social-media-blocking apps to offline experiences, the desire to disconnect is creating a new market. Is Gen Z rejecting technology - or simply learning when to put it down? Palki Sharma tells you.
